map.光子产生正负电子对所需最小能量。: The minimum energy a photon needs to produce an electron-positron pair.

map.：>1.022MeV 的部分转为正负电子动能与反冲核动能。: The part above 1.022MeV converts into electron-positron kinetic energy and nuclear recoil kinetic energy.
map.需同时创生电子与正电子，各静能 0.511MeV。: It must create an electron and a positron at the same time, each with a rest energy of 0.511 MeV.
map.必须在核场附近？: Must it be near the nuclear field?
map.是；真空中需第三者（核）守恒动量，否则无法发生。: Yes; in a vacuum a third party (the nucleus) must conserve momentum, otherwise it cannot happen.
